reviewScope: Generic Circular Array 7.9 with actual native iteration and all five language bodies, each exercised with both integer and string instantiations.

questions.algorithm: Copy fixed storage and map logical indices through a normalized offset; each native iterator has an independent cursor.
questions.review: Read pinned Java CircularArray<T> and its test driver; the JavaScript push/pop sketch is not substituted for the iterable generic task. The independent binding starts from initial values instead of uninitialized size-only slots, with that adaptation explicit in the statement. Read all five actual class bodies. Positive rotation advances the logical front; modulo normalization occurs before bounded head addition in fixed-width languages, and empty rotation exits before division. Bounds checks precede Get/Set mapping so Python negative indexing and wrapped indices are not silently accepted. Native C#/Java generic classes, C++ template and Python Generic class preserve integer/string types; JavaScript preserves primitive types dynamically. The private harness invokes actual methods and native iteration protocols, never a user function that simulates transcript results. Independent physical list-slicing oracles cover exhaustive short operation pairs, both signed shift endpoints, invalid -1/n indices, random longer mixed traces, repeated/Unicode strings and 1000-element arrays. Separate interleaved iterators and exhaustion are exercised. Caller input storage is snapshotted throughout later updates. Twenty distinct compiled variant implementations across five languages exercise forty typed fixtures: aliasing storage, skipped negative bounds and shared cursors are rejected; inverse-offset representations remain O(1) and are accepted. The private observer never reads head/items fields or forces an offset convention. C++ value-copy Get cost and const iterator reference/proxy behavior are described accurately.

languageBindingReview.csharp: Read actual CircularArray<T>:IEnumerable<T>, cloned T[] storage, independent yield-enumerator cursor, both explicit index checks and remainder normalization before head addition. Get/Set/Rotate delegates enforce the declared generic result and void methods. Both integer and string instantiations compile and execute.
languageBindingReview.java: Read actual generic List<T> constructor, private ArrayList<T> copy, Math.floorMod normalization and per-iterator cursor. next() enforces NoSuchElementException after exhaustion. The compiled harness exercises Integer/String instantiations and checks void Set/Rotate methods through their erased public signatures.
languageBindingReview.cpp: Read actual template class and vector<T> ownership. Get returns T by value, Set borrows const T&, rotation avoids signed overflow, and const range iteration owns cursor/owner values. vector<T>::const_reference avoids dangling references for proxy specializations. The harness compiles integer/string instantiations and invokes const indexing/iteration; deep copying arbitrary element objects is not promised.
languageBindingReview.python: Read the actual Generic/TypeVar class and visible typing imports, input list copy, explicit negative-index rejection and positive-divisor modulo. Each generator owns a local cursor. Primitive type observations reject bool-as-int/string coercions and both integer/string traces execute against the same generic class.
languageBindingReview.javascript: Read actual slice-based storage isolation, normalized negative remainder and Symbol.iterator generator. Independent generator cursors are interleaved with native next() calls. Result values retain their original number/string type and caller input values remain unchanged after Set/Rotate.
